drifted.spec_text: evict_next() delegates victim selection to the eviction policy (`identify_next_to_evict(pool_id)`), then removes that slot and frees its allocation; there is no shard round-robin counter
drifted.actual: The victim is popped from the policy at lib.rs:452 before the pool write lock is taken at :465. If the slot was removed meanwhile, nothing is freed but Some(key) is returned and the evictions counter is bumped (:467-473). In the same window, recycled LRU indices (lru_list.rs:38-46,143; no generation in EvictionHandle) let remove(K) delete another key's LRU node (lib.rs:511), leaving that key untracked and impossible to evict.

drifted.spec_text: Concurrent access from 16+ threads does not deadlock or corrupt state
drifted.actual: No multi-threaded test exists. get/touch/batch_touch call the policy after dropping the pool lock (lib.rs:417-419,525-527,561-565). A racing clear (lib.rs:613-617 -> LruList::clear lru_list.rs:147-153) empties the node vector, so move_to_back indexes out of bounds (lru_list.rs:70-71) and panics while holding the policy's pool mutex (eviction-policy-lru/src/lib.rs:84-85), poisoning it. The FR-013 ABA path also corrupts the slot/policy correspondence. No deadlock found (lock order is always state -> pool -> policy).

drifted.spec_text: All operations check initialized flag before proceeding
drifted.actual: Checked in insert/get/peek/oldest_keys/evict_next/remove/touch/batch_touch/contains/capacity/used/pool_info/clear/free_capacity. But insert returns InvalidSize for size 0 before the check (lib.rs:329-331 vs :334), batch_touch([]) returns before it (:532), and is_dma_capable (:621-624) and telemetry_snapshot (:626-646) never check it.

drifted.spec_text: When compiled with the optional `telemetry` feature, the component tracks eviction count, write-lock contention count, and read-lock contention count (+ spec.md:239: a failed try_read/try_write first attempt bumps the corresponding counter)
drifted.actual: Write contention is counted only in insert/evict_next/remove (lib.rs:342-352,453-463,493-503), not clear (:613). Read contention is counted only in get/batch_touch (:400-410,544-554), not peek/touch/contains/capacity/used/free_capacity. The evictions counter is bumped even when no slot was freed (:470-471).

drifted.spec_text: Allocator uses BTreeMap for O(log n) first-fit search
drifted.actual: First-fit is a linear scan over free regions: allocate uses iter().find (allocator.rs:53) and the new can_allocate uses values().any (:42), O(k). Only map updates and coalesce lookups are O(log k). insert now scans twice (lib.rs:362,375).
